Comment.value: Crash Party event item. Plot+Cursed on purpose: undroppable, unsellable, unstealable, unbankable. Cursed means 'cannot be dropped' only, so a worn one can still be taken off. Charges live in the CP_USES item local (cp_inc.nss) and are never shown to the player. WORN item, same hook as the Crown. Shares the Mask's CP_MASK_TRUEFORM stash so the two cannot restore each other's borrowed face. One charge per EQUIP.
